nodes.title: Owner's whole-project audit, Studio list (docs/design/round7/audit/studio.md on claude/r7-audit-studio; each finding verified before fixing). STUDIO-11: without a judge lane (FORGE3_QA_URL unset) Stagecraft no longer launches the generated_spec rung (lesson.js judgeRungsCfg passes every other rung; preferredRung falls to engine_default): the tray gate refuses every unjudged spec, so each launch (~$0.0013 on taxila-fast-bg) bought nothing. Reverse when a judge lane is wired. STUDIO-01: shade-grid@1's shown fraction moved to y0 + H + 56 under the rows label (audit patch 003; 0/2 → 2/2). STUDIO-02/03: catalogue boards follow the blind cross-check like the game and explainer (patch 004; 1/3 → 3/3); the 13 topics whose check failed (7) or never ran (6) stay withheld, not hand-fixed, until they are re-authored and re-checked. STUDIO-05: beat-card dots (src/studio/beatDots.ts) keep one dot 'now' from the 9th board. STUDIO-09: number-line-hop@1 refuses up front ('hops_layout') and board-ref advertises only what lays out: all hops one way, or two where the second goes back at most half the first; landings within 30; with 2+ hops each ≥ 2 and ≥ 1/8 of the spread (1/5 with a 3-character number); the equation row is centred. STUDIO-08: one Stagecraft mode default ('on', config.js stagecraftMode) for lesson.js and StagecraftHost. STUDIO-10: picture.js forgets a lesson's count, failure and finished jobs when the seam forgets the lesson, and caps jobs at 500. STUDIO-07: the Studio v2 node tests moved to tests/studio-v2.test.mjs (now run by npm test and test:all).

Deleted after the owner's audit (STUDIO-04, STUDIO-06); the last commit that holds each is b1fc76f7d. server/routes/forge.js (POST /api/forge/requests and /api/forge/prefetch: no caller anywhere; the lesson warms fills through forgeSeam.prefetchLessonFills), with its publicFill and limit tests and shared/forge.ts ForgeRequestResponse. The five applied Studio seam patches: server/forge/seam-patches/w1b-lesson-wiring.patch, w2b-parts-repair.patch, w2b-watch-only.patch; server/studio/seam-patches/w2h-say-screen-targets.patch, w2h-turn-slot.patch (read first: every hunk is in turn.js in a later form; its facts row is superseded by factsRowForSlot / withFactsRows). context/ entries that cite them by name as the tree a measurement ran on read them at b1fc76f7d. The seven seam patches of other streams (brain, comprehension, director, relational) are not Studio's and stay.
